source: Production runs with the settings in protocol.json

reproducibility.sparse_cell: Regenerating all 30 runs reproduces the QSP hitting times to relative 1e-12 or better
reproducibility.dense_cell: First 20 steps reproduced exactly and frozen-kernel hitting times to relative 1e-10; the full 500000-step run takes several hours
reproducibility.occupancy_scan_and_initialization: Regenerated points and samples agree with the supplied values to within 1e-11
